name: youtube-agent
description: Fork of Jake Schincariol's eleven YouTube skills, with tests, a script linter and a hardened hook scorer: scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list from your transcript, a retention reader that finds the exact moments people leave, a Shorts cutter, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, and a virality engine that ranks your niche by outlier multiple rather than by channel size.
